description: Search the Kismet network for vacation-rental collections (property managers). Returns ranked collections with their slug (`collection_id`), regions, property count, and supported tools. Use this when the guest asks which managers operate in a place or wants to choose a manager. It is not required before network-wide search: search_bookables and discover_collections span every collection when `collections` is omitted. Searchable via free-text `query` plus optional `region`/`category` filters — not a full dump.

query.description: Free-text search across name, region, and description.

region.description: Filter by region, state, or country (e.g. "Oregon").

name: list_collections

collections.description: Ranked collections matching the query / filters.

collection_id.description: Stable slug — pass this in the `collections` array of property tools.

tool_capabilities.description: Manager-side tool names this collection exposes.

title: List Vacation-Rental Collections
